# NumPy npm Boundary

This bounded fixture makes no claim that the npm package named `numpy` belongs
to the NumPy project, and it does not claim that NumPy has no npm identity.
The npm catalog dimension is therefore `unknown`, non-exhaustive, and contains
no identities.

The fixture is authorized only for onboarding a different real **pip**
distribution. Any npm onboarding request must fail closed until a separately
reviewed npm fixture establishes complete identity coverage.
